ruleDefinitions.name: User Added to Local Administrator Group
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the addition of a new member to the local administrator group, which could be legitimate activity or a sign of privilege escalation activity Note: Unmapped fields: TargetSid

sequences.query: (event_id = 4732 AND (dest_user = RGX("^Administr") OR TargetSid = "S\-1\-5\-32\-544")) AND  NOT (user = RGX("\\$$"))
